title: Identifying the derived internal hom along a resolution with a composition of adjoints
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the derived internal hom along a ring map, in the situation of a chosen resolution, with the composition of the derived internal hom out of the resolution and the equivalence given by tensoring up along it (author lemma at source lines 2547-2553, label lemma-RHom-dga). The proof (source lines 2555-2563) observes that the first functor is the right adjoint of the derived tensor product with the resolution, that this is the same role played by the internal hom along the ring map, and concludes that the two must correspond under the stated equivalence (proof lines 2559-2562). The adjunction comparison is the substance. H2.
